title: Can RPG Maker MV publish games of different types.

posts.author: Fira
posts.body: I am talking about can RPG Maker MV publish games to like smartphones, tablets, GooglePlay Store, HTML 5 and others?

posts.author: Crimson_Ruin
posts.body: Of Cause it can't cause it is not like the site, steam or a thread dedicated it exists.

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
RPG Maker MV makes HTML games. The target system only requires a HTML5-compliant browser. The editor only provides support for deploying a project; publication/distribution is up to you.
Standalone deployment just packs your game with a Chromium browser. It's still an HTML game.
I don't know the details of mobile deployment, I haven't looked into it in depth. I think it involves deploying either for Android/iOS or Web, then going through additional steps based on exactly which mobile platform you want to target.
Isn't Google Play just a way of sharing apps, like Itch, Steam, etc? If so, you'd deploy for the appropriate platform(s), then upload the results for distribution to your audience.
